aubergine-lasagne.blurb: Steamed aubergine and tomato layered with two cheeses.
aubergine-lasagne.kit: 1 pan with colander, 1 frying pan, 1 oven dish
steps: Heat the oven to 200C. Pierce the aubergines and steam them for about 30 minutes, then scoop out and chop the flesh.
Fry the garlic, thyme, aubergine and crumbled chilli in the oil for 10 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and balsamic with most of the basil and simmer for 10 minutes until thick. Season.
Grate the Parmesan and half the Cheddar, and slice the rest.
Layer sauce, grated cheese and pasta three times in the dish, then finish with sauce and all the remaining cheese.
Bake on a low shelf for 25 to 30 minutes until golden.
aubergine-lasagne.title: Aubergine lasagne

carrot-ginger-soup.blurb: Roasted carrots blended with curry spices and coconut milk.
carrot-ginger-soup.kit: 1 oven tray, 1 large pot, 1 stick blender
carrot-ginger-soup.note: Makes about 3 litres, so there should be plenty left for another night.
steps: Heat the oven to 220C. Chop the carrots into chunks, toss with 1 tbsp oil and seasoning, and roast for about 25 minutes.
Meanwhile, cook the onions, celery and ginger in the rest of the oil with a pinch of salt, covered on low, for 15 minutes.
Stir in the spices, then add the carrots, coconut milk and two tins of water. Bring to a simmer.
Blend until smooth and season. Add water if it is too thick.
carrot-ginger-soup.title: Carrot ginger coconut soup

chicken-katharina.blurb: Leeks, chicken and gruyère in a mustard sauce under a crisp crumb.
chicken-katharina.kit: 1 large frying pan, 1 oven dish, 2 bowls
chicken-katharina.note: The recipe sheet says the Parma ham can be left out.
shopping: 4 to 5 chicken breasts, about 700g, in 1cm strips
chicken-katharina.source: Your family recipe sheet, from your photo
steps: Cook the leeks gently in 2 tbsp oil for 15 to 20 minutes until soft, then lift them out.
Add the sherry and stock to the pan and boil until reduced by about a quarter. Let it cool.
Mix the crème fraîche, flour, mustard, sage, 1 tbsp parsley and seasoning. Stir in the reduced stock, chicken and leeks.
Tip into an oven dish and sprinkle over the gruyère.
Toss the breadcrumbs with 3 tbsp oil, the ham if using, and the rest of the parsley. Scatter over the top.
Bake at 190C for 50 to 60 minutes until bubbling at the edges and golden on top.
chicken-katharina.title: Chicken Katharina

chicken-marbella.blurb: Chicken baked with prunes, olives and capers until sticky.
chicken-marbella.note: Marinate overnight, so start the day before. These quantities feed about 10, so quarter them for the family.
steps: The day before, mix the oil, vinegar, prunes, olives, capers, bay, garlic, oregano and seasoning. Coat the chicken and chill overnight.
Heat the oven to 180C. Spread the chicken and marinade in one layer on shallow trays.
Sprinkle with the sugar and pour the wine around the pieces.
Bake for 50 to 60 minutes, basting often, until the juices run clear.
Move everything to a platter with some of the pan juices and the herbs.
chicken-marbella.title: Chicken Marbella

chicken-satay-noodle-salad.blurb: Griddled chicken and pineapple tossed with noodles and fresh herbs.
steps: Heat a griddle pan on medium. Drain the pineapple and keep the juice.
Cover the noodles and vegetables with boiling water for 5 minutes, then drain.
Make the dressing on a large platter: grated garlic, chilli and lime zest, plus teriyaki, peanut butter, pineapple juice and lime juice.
Char the pineapple on both sides, then chop it.
Coat the chicken in a third of the dressing and griddle for about 4 minutes a side.
Toss the noodles, vegetables, pineapple and most of the herbs in the dressing. Top with sliced chicken, sesame oil, sesame seeds and the remaining herbs and chilli.
chicken-satay-noodle-salad.title: Chicken satay noodle salad

classic-tiramisu.blurb: Coffee, mascarpone and cocoa. No oven, but it needs time in the fridge.
classic-tiramisu.kit: 1 electric mixer, 3 bowls, 1 shallow bowl, 1 dish
classic-tiramisu.note: Chill for at least 4 hours, ideally a full day.
classic-tiramisu.source: NYT Cooking, reposted on LGF Pages
steps: Beat the yolks with half the sugar until pale and thick.
Whip the cream with the remaining sugar, beat in the mascarpone and fold into the yolks.
Mix the coffee and rum in a shallow bowl. Sift half the cocoa over the base of the dish.
Dip the ladyfingers quickly in the coffee and lay them in the dish. Spread on half the cream, then repeat.
Sift over the remaining cocoa, add grated chocolate if you like, and chill.
classic-tiramisu.title: Classic tiramisù

coconut-cauliflower-adobo.blurb: Charred cauliflower in a sharp, sweet soy and coconut sauce.
coconut-cauliflower-adobo.kit: 1 oven tray, 1 frying pan, 1 rice pot
shopping: Spring onions and lime, to serve
steps: Start the rice. Heat the grill to high.
Spread the cauliflower on a tray with 2 tbsp oil and some pepper. Grill for 3 to 4 minutes until it starts to char.
Stir together the soy, vinegar, coconut milk, honey, chilli flakes and 60ml water.
Fry the shallots and garlic in the last tbsp of oil in a deep frying pan for 1 to 2 minutes.
Turn the heat down, add the sauce, cauliflower and bay. Bring to the boil, then simmer on medium for 15 minutes, adding a splash of water if it gets thick.
Take out the bay leaves. Serve over the rice with spring onions and lime.
coconut-cauliflower-adobo.title: Coconut cauliflower adobo

greek-sheet-pan-chicken.blurb: Lemon and oregano chicken roasted on one tray, with feta on top.
steps: Heat the oven to 220C. Mix the chicken with 2 tbsp oil, the zest and juice of 1 lemon, balsamic, oregano, paprika, shallot, 4 garlic cloves, chilli, salt and pepper. Leave for 15 to 20 minutes.
Toss the potatoes with 2 tbsp oil and seasoning on a tray, add the other lemon, halved, and roast for 20 minutes.
Add the chicken, peppers and onion to the tray, drizzle with the last tbsp of oil and roast for 20 to 25 minutes more.
Mix the sun-dried tomatoes, olives and feta in one bowl. Mix the yogurt, remaining garlic and a pinch of salt in another.
Serve the tray with the feta mix, yogurt and herbs on top.
greek-sheet-pan-chicken.title: Greek sheet pan chicken and potatoes

honey-ginger-salmon-bowl.blurb: Sticky salmon over rice with a mango and peach salsa.
shopping: 4 salmon fillets, about 150g each, in chunks
steps: Cook the rice. Mix the tamari, fish sauce, honey, ginger and sambal in a bowl.
Melt the butter in a large frying pan and cook the salmon skin-down for 3 minutes until crisp.
Turn it, lower the heat, add the garlic for a minute, then pour in the sauce and cook for 3 minutes. Lift the salmon out.
Add 60ml water to the pan and scrape it together into a sauce.
Mix the mango, peach, jalapeños, herbs, lime and a little salt.
Serve the salmon on the rice with the sauce and salsa.
honey-ginger-salmon-bowl.title: Crispy honey ginger salmon bowl

kedgeree-leeks-spinach.blurb: Creamy smoked haddock rice with herbs and boiled eggs.
kedgeree-leeks-spinach.kit: 1 rice pot, 1 fish pan, 1 egg pan, 1 large frying pan
steps: Boil the rice, then drain and rinse it cold. Hard-boil the eggs.
Warm the milk with the bay and cardamom, turn off the heat, add the fish and leave covered for 10 minutes. Lift out the fish and keep the milk.
Cook the leeks and garlic slowly in the butter and oil for 10 to 15 minutes.
Add the curry powder and chilli, then fold in the rice and milk and bring to a simmer.
Add the spinach until wilted, then the crème fraîche, herbs and lemon. Season and fork through the fish.
Top with the halved eggs, more herbs and the piment.
kedgeree-leeks-spinach.title: Kedgeree with leeks and spinach

kipfilet-mango-roomsaus.title: Chicken with mango in a spicy cream sauce
kipfilet-mango-roomsaus.blurb: Chicken and sweet mango in a quick, hot cream sauce.
kipfilet-mango-roomsaus.note: Claude wrote this as a starting point because the original recipe could not be read. Adjust it the first time you cook it.
steps: Start the rice.
Brown the chicken in the oil over a high heat, then lift it out.
Soften the onion, garlic and chilli for 5 minutes, then stir in the curry powder for a minute.
Add the cream and bring to a gentle simmer.
Return the chicken and add the mango. Cook for 5 minutes until the chicken is done, season and serve with the rice.

masala-hake.blurb: Silky poached fish in a deep spiced sauce with crispy onions.
masala-hake.kit: 1 food processor, 1 small pan, 1 large sauté pan, 1 bowl
shopping: 1 tbsp rice wine or white wine
½ tsp carom seeds, or fennel seeds
steps: Whisk the egg white, cornflour and wine, coat the fish and leave for 30 minutes.
Blend the spices, ginger, garlic, tomato paste, sugar, 30g of the basil and 50ml water to a paste.
Blanch the fish in boiling water in three batches, 20 seconds each, and drain in a colander.
Fry the onions in the oil for 15 minutes until deep brown, add the paste and fry for 10 minutes.
Add the stock, half the coconut milk and salt, and cook for 20 minutes until thick.
Stir in the fish and remaining basil, cover off the heat for 5 minutes. Serve with crispy onions, the rest of the coconut milk and lime.
masala-hake.title: Masala hake with coconut milk

ottolenghi-orzo-prawns.blurb: Everything cooks in one pan like a quick risotto.
ottolenghi-orzo-prawns.kit: 1 large sauté pan with lid, 1 small bowl
shopping: 4 tsp fennel seeds, toasted and crushed
ottolenghi-orzo-prawns.source: Ottolenghi Simple, via The Happy Foodie
steps: Mix the feta with a little of the chilli and fennel and 1 tbsp oil, then set aside.
Toast the orzo in 2 tbsp oil until golden, then take it out of the pan.
Fry the remaining chilli and fennel, garlic and orange peel in the rest of the oil for a moment. Add the tomatoes, stock, 200ml water and seasoning and bring to the boil.
Return the orzo, cover and simmer for about 15 minutes, stirring now and then. Uncover for the last minute or two.
Stir in the prawns until pink, add the basil and top with the feta.
ottolenghi-orzo-prawns.title: Orzo with prawns and feta

peanut-noodles-halloumi.blurb: Takeaway-style noodles with mango and crisp halloumi.
steps: Boil the noodles as the packet says, then drain.
Blend the peanut butter, soy, 2 tbsp sesame oil, honey, sambal, curry paste, ginger, garlic and 120ml water until smooth.
Toss the sauce through the hot noodles with the lime juice, herbs, carrots, pepper, mango and edamame.
Fry the halloumi in the last tbsp of sesame oil for about 5 minutes until golden, then put it on top.
peanut-noodles-halloumi.title: Peanut noodles with halloumi

puy-lentils-aubergine.blurb: Smoky roasted aubergine and burst tomatoes. Keeps for 3 days in the fridge.
puy-lentils-aubergine.kit: 1 oven tray, 1 lentil pot (none with ready-cooked), 1 large bowl
puy-lentils-aubergine.note: Make it up to 3 days ahead and add the yogurt just before serving.
puy-lentils-aubergine.serves: 4 as a side, 2 as a main
steps: Heat the oven as high as it goes, up to 245C. Prick the aubergines and roast for 1 hour, turning once, until very soft.
When cool enough, scoop the flesh into a colander and let it drain for 30 minutes.
Roast the tomatoes on the same tray for 12 minutes until split.
Boil the lentils for about 20 minutes until just tender, then drain. Skip this if using ready-cooked.
Mix the lentils, aubergine, tomatoes, oil, lemon, garlic, 2 tbsp oregano, ¾ tsp salt and pepper.
Spoon into a wide bowl, swirl through the yogurt and finish with the remaining oregano and a little oil.
puy-lentils-aubergine.title: Puy lentils with aubergine and yogurt

red-pepper-tortellini.blurb: A blitzed roasted pepper sauce with burrata torn over the top.
steps: Put a big pot of salted water on to boil.
Soften the shallots and garlic in 2 tbsp oil for 5 minutes, then blend them with the peppers until smooth.
In the same pan, cook the tomato paste, oregano and chilli in the rest of the oil for 4 minutes. Add the vodka for 2 minutes.
Stir in the pepper sauce, cream, parmesan, spinach and basil, and season.
Boil the tortellini, drain, toss in the sauce and top with burrata.
red-pepper-tortellini.title: Creamy red pepper tortellini

roast-chicken-lemon-potatoes.blurb: Two hours in total, nearly all of it in the oven.
steps: Heat the oven to 190C and season the chicken inside and out.
Boil the potatoes with the whole lemon and the garlic for about 12 minutes. Drain, take out the lemon and garlic, and shake the potatoes to rough them up.
Prick the hot lemon. Oil the chicken and stuff it with the lemon, garlic and thyme. Roast for 45 minutes.
Lift the chicken out, toss the potatoes and rosemary in the tray fat, and put the chicken back on top. Add the bacon if using.
Roast for 45 minutes more, then rest and carve.
roast-chicken-lemon-potatoes.title: Roast chicken with lemon and rosemary potatoes

rosemary-chicken-meatballs-orzo.blurb: Baked meatballs on a creamy tomato orzo.
rosemary-chicken-meatballs-orzo.kit: 1 oven tray, 1 frying pan, 1 mixing bowl
steps: Heat the oven to 230C and soak the bread in 120ml warm water.
Soften half the shallot and garlic in 2 tbsp butter, then add the garlic granules and half the chilli.
Mix with the chicken, bread, 25g parmesan, sun-dried tomatoes, herbs and salt. Roll about 16 meatballs, drizzle with oil and bake for 25 to 30 minutes.
In the same pan, crisp the rosemary sprig in the last of the butter and a spoon of sun-dried tomato oil, then set it aside.
Cook the remaining shallot and garlic, then the tomato paste, chilli, wine and orzo. Add the stock and simmer until tender.
Stir in the cream, spinach and remaining parmesan. Serve with the meatballs and crisp rosemary.
rosemary-chicken-meatballs-orzo.title: Rosemary chicken meatballs with tomato orzo

scallops-champagne-sage.title: Scallops with champagne, sage butter and capers
scallops-champagne-sage.blurb: Seared scallops in a quick, sharp butter sauce.
scallops-champagne-sage.note: Claude wrote this as a starting point because the original recipe could not be read. Adjust it the first time you cook it.
steps: Pat the scallops dry and season them.
Sear in the oil in a very hot pan for about 90 seconds a side, then lift out.
Lower the heat, melt the butter and fry the sage and capers until the sage crisps.
Add the champagne and bubble for 2 minutes until slightly reduced, then squeeze in the lemon.
Return the scallops, spoon over the sauce and serve straight away.

shrimp-pad-thai.title: Prawn pad thai
shrimp-pad-thai.blurb: Sweet, sour and salty noodles, all made in one wok.
shrimp-pad-thai.source: Martha Stewart. The saved link no longer goes to this recipe
shrimp-pad-thai.note: Claude wrote this as a starting point because the original recipe could not be read. Adjust it the first time you cook it.
steps: Soak the noodles in hot water as the packet says, then drain.
Mix the fish sauce, tamarind and sugar.
Fry the garlic and prawns in the oil in a hot wok until the prawns turn pink, then push them to one side.
Scramble the eggs in the space, then add the noodles and sauce and toss for 2 to 3 minutes.
Toss through the bean sprouts and spring onions. Serve with the peanuts and lime.
